title: 第十三章 如日中天大骑士之威第十四章 仰望剑术精进
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: “北海鲛人？那也是三阶的兽人肉，不过那种兽人比较少，而且在水里难以猎杀，基本上要一百五十银币一斤。这次没有收到这种肉。”
老太太眯着眼打量李奥，“怎么样，问来问去，到底要不要买。我古婆婆做买卖明码标价，所有肉我都只翻一倍价格，童叟无欺。”
李奥看着这自称古婆婆的老太婆。
他还是第一次见到卖家直接说他翻倍卖的。
如果她说的是真的，那么作为王国商队独家经营。
她翻一倍，比起前世的一些奸商，算是不错了。
而且听亚瑟说，这王国商队不比其他野路子商队，商家有丹伦王国的担保，卖的东西有质量保障。
“能不能便宜点，我买的多。”李奥习惯性地开始砍价。
“买多少。”古婆婆问道。
“一斤吧。”
“才买一斤？！也叫多？我这最小的砝码就是一斤！”古婆婆声音尖利，感觉到面前这个小子有些难缠。
“那有没有其他折扣。”
“等我百岁，给你们便宜两成。”
“百岁。”李奥看着对方，“那您现在？”
“九十七，还要等三年。”
李奥无语……那就是还要等三年。
‘这老太婆能不能活那么久还另说呢。‘心里想着，李奥面露犹豫之色。
古婆婆被李奥问得有点不耐烦，“到底买不买。不买就不要打听来打听去。”
大概是因为垄断经营的关系，这老太婆完全不怕失去李奥这个客户。
态度可以说相当恶劣。
“古婆婆，最后一个问题，岩地侏儒和沼泽鳄人的肉有什么区别。”
“哎呀，对骑士来说，适合不同的呼吸法，对你来说，没有任何区别，可能鳄人的肉腥气大点。”古婆婆已经开始摆弄起烟袋。
李奥将两种肉放在手里，看来看去，来回比较。“能不能先尝尝。”
“见鬼了，不能！”
李奥想了又想，最终他选择了两种肉各要半斤，“各帮我称半斤吧。”
“该死，半斤怎么卖，我还是头一次见贵族的孩子这么抠门的。”古婆婆耷拉着脸皮。
李奥尴尬地笑笑，他也是无奈，一共就十二枚银币在身上。
这一下子就差不多花完了。
各买半斤回去比较一下效果吧。
古婆婆鼓捣着她的天平，反反复复调整盘子里的肉干，直到最后指针正正好好停在正中。
“看好了啊，王国商队专用秤。老少无欺。”古婆婆将包好的肉干随便一扔。
而李奥已经是跑到了另一边的药材前，“古婆婆，买了这么多，这些能不能送我一点。”
“咳！咳！”古婆婆刚点上的火柴被她的咳灭，她已经破防，从来没见过来买兽人肉的这么啰嗦。
“该死的小吝啬鬼，要不是面对面，我还以为在跟狡猾的地精矮子在做生意。”
“地精矮子？”
古婆婆不再和李奥废话。
她每样药材都捏了一点点，一把扔进了口袋，“拿去拿去。别让其他客人看到，我的摊子可从来没有开过这个先例。”
说完，她一把接过李奥递出的银币。
躺在后面的躺椅上，抽了口烟袋，才稍稍平复一些怒气。
另一边，李奥揣紧了剩下的最后两个银币。
他将包裹揣进怀里，看到另一边的亚瑟已经被一个卖兽皮的摊子吸引。
李奥加快了步伐。
刚刚他最后要的那点药材，其实暂时并没有什么用，只不过是前世去菜场买菜讨葱的习惯。
不过，他知道骑士六艺之中，有一艺便是医术。
content_en:
"Hornic? That's also third-level orc meat, but that kind of orc is relatively rare and difficult to hunt in the water. It basically costs one hundred and fifty silver coins per pound. I didn't receive this kind of meat this time."
The old lady squinted her eyes and looked at Leo, "How are you doing? I've been asking around and asking if I want to buy it. My ancient mother-in-law has clearly marked the prices when doing business. I only double the price of all the meat, so I don't bully others."
Leo looked at the old woman who called herself Granny Gu.
This was the first time that he saw the seller directly telling him that he had doubled the price.
If what she said is true, then as a kingdom caravan exclusive.
She has doubled, which is not bad compared to some profiteers in her previous life.
And I heard from Arthur that this kingdom’s caravan is no better than other wild caravans. The merchants have the guarantee of the Kingdom of Danlun, and the quality of the goods they sell is guaranteed.
"Can it be cheaper? I bought a lot." Leo started to bargain out of habit.
"How much do you want to buy?" Grandma Gu asked.
"One pound, maybe."
"I only bought one pound?! How much is that? My smallest weight is one pound!" Grandma Gu's voice was sharp, and she felt that the boy in front of her was a bit difficult to deal with.
"Are there any other discounts?"
"When I turn 100, I'll give you 20% off."
"A hundred years old." Leo looked at the other party, "What about you now?"
"Ninety-seven, we have to wait three years."
Leo was speechless...that means we have to wait three years.
‘Whether this old woman can live that long is another question. 'Thinking to himself, Leo looked hesitant.
Grandma Gu was a little impatient when Leo asked her, "Should I buy it or not? If you don't want to buy it, don't ask around."
Probably because of the monopoly operation, this old woman is not afraid of losing Leo as a customer.
The attitude can be said to be quite bad.
"Granny Gu, one last question, what is the difference between the meat of a rock gnome and a swamp crocodile?"
"Oh, for knights, different breathing methods are suitable. For you, there is no difference. Maybe the crocodile meat smells more fishy." Granny Gu has already started to play with the pipe.
Leo put the two kinds of meat in his hands, looked at them, and compared them back and forth. "Can you try it first?"
"Hell no!"
Leo thought again and again, and finally he chose half a catty of each type of meat, "Weigh half a catty each for me."
"Damn, how can you sell half a catty? This is the first time I have seen a noble child so stingy." Grandma Gu said with a droopy face.
Leo smiled awkwardly, he was helpless, he only had twelve silver coins on him.
It was almost all spent at once.
Let’s buy half a catty of each and compare the effects.
Grandma Gu fiddled with her scale, adjusting the dried meat on the plate again and again until the pointer finally stopped exactly in the middle.
"Look carefully, it's a special scale for the kingdom's caravans. Young and old should not be bullied." Granny Gu threw the wrapped dried meat away casually.
And Leo had already run to the medicinal materials on the other side, "Grandma Gu, I bought so much, can you give me some of these."
"Cough! Cough!" The match that Granny Gu had just lit was extinguished by her cough. She had already broken her guard. She had never seen someone who came to buy orc meat be so verbose.
"Damn little miser, if we weren't face to face, I would have thought I was doing business with a cunning goblin dwarf."
"Goblin dwarf?"
Granny Gu stopped talking nonsense to Leo.
She pinched a little of each medicinal ingredient and threw it into her pocket, "Take it and take it. Don't let other customers see it. My stall has never opened this precedent."
After saying that, she took the silver coin handed out by Leo.
Lying on the lounge chair in the back, he took a puff from his pipe and calmed down his anger a little.
On the other side, Leo held onto the last two silver coins.
He put the package in his arms and saw that Arthur on the other side had been attracted by a stall selling animal skins.
Leo quickened his pace.
The last few medicinal materials he asked for just now are actually of no use at the moment. They are just a habit of going to the market to buy vegetables and ask for green onions in his previous life.
However, he knew that one of the six knightly arts was medicine.
